# Georgian Baked Goods

> Georgian bakery (Georgia the country, in the Caucasus) in Etobicoke, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Bakes khachapuri, khinkali, lobiani, kubdari and Georgian/Eastern European sweets by hand, daily. Pickup only: order by phone or online, pay at pickup. Owner and baker: Valeriy.

- Address: 10 Plastics Ave., Unit 100, Etobicoke, ON M8Z 4B7, Canada
- Phone: 647 479 8929 (+1-647-479-8929)
- Email: sales@georgianbakedgoods.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 am – 7:00 pm
- Order online (pickup): https://georgianbakedgoods.com/order.html
- Large orders and catering: welcome — call or email
- Google Maps listing and reviews (rated 5.0): https://www.google.com/maps?cid=987112567569791948

## Guides
- [Khachapuri: a guide to Georgia's cheese breads, region by region](https://georgianbakedgoods.com/georgian-food/khachapuri/): Khachapuri (ხაჭაპური) is Georgia's national cheese bread: a yeasted dough wrapped around, or filled with, salty Georgian cheese. The name joins khacho (curd cheese) and puri (bread). Almost every region of Georgia has its own shape. The best known are round Imeruli, cheese-topped Megruli and boat-shaped Adjaruli with butter and an egg yolk.
- [Khinkali: Georgia's soup dumplings, and how to eat them](https://georgianbakedgoods.com/georgian-food/khinkali/): Khinkali (ხინკალი) are large Georgian dumplings: a thin dough pleated into a twisted topknot around spiced minced meat. As they cook, the meat releases broth that stays inside. You eat them by hand: hold the knot, bite a small opening, sip the broth, then eat the rest and leave the knot on the plate.
- [Lobiani, kubdari and chebureki: Georgia's filled breads](https://georgianbakedgoods.com/georgian-food/lobiani-kubdari/): Lobiani is a Georgian bread filled with seasoned, mashed red beans. Its name comes from lobio, Georgian for beans. Kubdari is a bread from the mountain region of Svaneti, filled with hand-chopped spiced meat and onion. Both are baked like khachapuri, but with a different filling.
- [Qada, Medovik and Spartak: the sweets on a Georgian table](https://georgianbakedgoods.com/georgian-food/georgian-sweets/): Qada (ქადა) is a Georgian sweet pastry: soft layered dough wrapped around a crumbly filling of flour, butter and sugar. Medovik is a layered honey cake with sweet cream, and Spartak is its chocolate cousin. Both cakes come from the Russian and Soviet baking tradition and are a fixture in Georgian homes and bakeries.
